Title: Public preview: Performance Test Web Apps and Mobile Apps

Body.Content:
You can now load test the Web Apps and Mobile Apps features in Azure App Service to verify the app's performance under load. You can generate thousands of virtual users from various locations across the globe to simulate real-world traffic on your application. Use it for free with the public preview of this functionality. For more information, see:
  • Performance test your web app under load (instructions)
  • Performance Testing Web Applications from Visual Studio Enterprise with Manas Maheshwari (video)
